coverage_policy: Every baseline relation in v3_identity and v3_private requires one disposition

entries.logical_domain: Account root and closure state
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct: account_id is the data-subject account root.
entries.export_behavior: Include account identifier and lifecycle timestamps/state in the subject export.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Close the account and orchestrate relation-specific deletion, revocation, withdrawal, or pseudonymisation; do not assume a database cascade.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Record closure/deletion completion in the durable deletion ledger; immutable backups expire by backup schedule and must not restore live identity state.

entries.logical_domain: External authentication linkage
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through external_identity.account_id.
entries.export_behavior: Include provider, issuer, subject and verification/disable metadata for the owning account.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Disable immediately, then remove or irreversibly pseudonymise the provider subject after the security retention window.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Deletion ledger stores only the completion proof and non-reversible reference; backup copies age out on the security backup schedule.

entries.logical_domain: Mutable in-game identity shared through access edges
entries.ownership_resolution: Resolve all active account_commander_access edges; a Commander may have one owner and additional editors/viewers.
entries.export_behavior: Include the Commander profile for each entitled account and label it as a potentially shared logical identity.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Remove or revoke the requesting account's access edge; archive/delete the shared Commander only when no remaining entitlement or legal purpose exists.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records edge removal separately from Commander archival; backups must not reattach removed account access.

entries.logical_domain: Shared ownership and access-control edge
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct by account_id, with the linked Commander resolved independently because it can be shared.
entries.export_behavior: Include role, grant, revocation and linked Commander identifier for the account.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Revoke/delete the account edge without cascading the shared Commander; preserve only bounded authorization evidence where required.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records revoked edge and effective time; backup restore processing must reapply revocation.

entries.logical_domain: External identity attached to a potentially shared Commander
entries.ownership_resolution: Resolve the Commander, then all entitled accounts; never infer one account owner from the row alone.
entries.export_behavior: Export to an entitled account with shared-identity context and provider subject details where policy permits.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Unlink only after resolving other entitled accounts and the provider linkage authority; otherwise redact from the requesting account's export/access path.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger distinguishes unlink, shared retention and redaction outcomes; backup restoration must preserve that outcome.

entries.logical_domain: Non-personal authorization vocabulary
entries.ownership_resolution: No data-subject owner; this is shared control-plane vocabulary.
entries.export_behavior: Export only as explanatory reference for an account_role assignment.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: No per-person delete; govern catalogue lifecycle separately.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Normal configuration backup policy; no personal deletion-ledger row is required for the catalogue itself.

entries.logical_domain: Account role grant/revocation history
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through account_role.account_id.
entries.export_behavior: Include role code plus grant and revocation timestamps.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Revoke active grants immediately; retain or pseudonymise bounded authorization history according to security policy.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records revocation; restored backups must not reactivate a revoked grant.

entries.logical_domain: User-bound authentication device
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through device_credential.account_id.
entries.export_behavior: Include credential kind, identifier and lifecycle metadata; do not export cryptographic key material as ordinary profile data.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Revoke immediately and delete key material after the security investigation/retention window.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records credential revocation/deletion without key material; backup copies expire under restricted security-backup handling.

entries.logical_domain: Account session and rotation chain
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through session.account_id; rotation links are constrained to the same account.
entries.export_behavior: Include bounded session lifecycle/device metadata, never the session token hash.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Revoke immediately; purge expired session rows and token hashes on the short security retention schedule.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Do not retain session payload in the deletion ledger; record account-wide revocation completion and let backups expire promptly.

entries.logical_domain: Export/delete request, verification and completion receipt
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through personal_data_request.account_id.
entries.export_behavior: Include request history, scope, state and safe completion receipt; protect result locators and hashes according to delivery policy.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Do not erase the compliance request receipt as if it were ordinary profile data; minimise/pseudonymise it after the legal retention period.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Retain a minimal immutable completion ledger through the required compliance period; backups follow the same minimisation outcome.

entries.logical_domain: Non-human system identity
entries.ownership_resolution: No account owner; the row identifies a governed non-human principal.
entries.export_behavior: Not part of a personal-data export except where referenced by a subject-visible audit event.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Retire through system-identity governance, not an account deletion cascade.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Normal restricted control-plane backup and retirement audit; no personal deletion-ledger entry.

entries.logical_domain: Non-human secret credential
entries.ownership_resolution: No account owner; resolve to service_principal.
entries.export_behavior: Never include credential hashes in a personal-data export.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Revoke/delete on system credential rotation or principal retirement.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Restricted secret-backup lifecycle and system credential audit; no personal deletion-ledger entry.

entries.logical_domain: Append-only account or service-principal security outcome
entries.ownership_resolution: Account-owned when account_id is present; otherwise a non-human service-principal event. Detail may contain additional subject references requiring review.
entries.export_behavior: Export safe account-linked event metadata with security-sensitive detail and third-party identifiers redacted.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Do not cascade-delete audit evidence; minimise or pseudonymise account references after the security/legal retention window.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Retain append-only audit/deletion proof for the governed period; backup restoration must preserve pseudonymisation and revocation outcomes.

entries.logical_domain: Account-bound legacy claim with optional shared Commander link
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct account ownership through account_id; Commander context resolves through access edges and may be shared.
entries.export_behavior: Include claim lifecycle and linked Commander context, never the sync-key hash.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Revoke the claim and remove/pseudonymise its account link after migration-security retention; do not delete a shared Commander by cascade.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records irreversible claim revocation without the key hash; backups must not reactivate the claim.

entries.logical_domain: Short-lived single-use Frontier OAuth state nonce for the login flow
entries.ownership_resolution: Not account-owned: transient control value binding the authorization request to the browser session; deleted after use or expiry.
entries.export_behavior: Never exported; store only the digest of the state value, never the raw value.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Delete after single use or expiry; purge expired rows on each login flow.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Backups must not resurrect an expired or consumed state; restore-time purge treats all rows as invalid.

entries.logical_domain: Account-owned private import with optional Commander context
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through owner_account_id; optional owner_commander_id must be resolved through that account's access edge.
entries.export_behavior: Include import metadata, source/artifact references and withdrawal state for the owner, subject to source-rights limits.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Mark withdrawn, stop processing/publication eligibility, and delete private payload descendants according to the owner request and retention policy.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger stores import identifier, withdrawal time and completion proof, not payload; backups expire and must reapply the tombstone.

entries.logical_domain: Account-owned private evidence payload
entries.ownership_resolution: Composite ownership through (private_import_id, owner_account_id); do not infer ownership from source_run_id.
entries.export_behavior: Include fact key, payload, observation metadata and source linkage for the owning account, subject to source-rights limits.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Withdraw and delete/minimise payload with the owning private import; separately process any contribution receipt and derived public effect.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records a non-payload fact tombstone; backups expire and derived-state recomputation must honor withdrawal.

entries.logical_domain: Contributor-bound sharing scope, attribution and decision
entries.ownership_resolution: Contributor is composite-bound to private_fact.owner_account_id; the receipt can also affect shared/public derived data and attribution.
entries.export_behavior: Include purpose, audience, site/API/bulk permissions, attribution choice and decision history for the contributor.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Withdraw rather than silently delete the decision; trigger recomputation/removal of affected derived publication while retaining a minimal policy receipt.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Retain minimal withdrawal/decision proof without private payload; restored backups must not republish a withdrawn contribution.

entries.logical_domain: Contributor-bound withdrawal and recomputation receipt
entries.ownership_resolution: Composite FK resolves requested_by_account_id to the original contribution's contributing account.
entries.export_behavior: Include request, reason, application time and safe recomputation status for the contributor.
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Retain as the authoritative withdrawal ledger; minimise free-text reason after its governed retention period rather than deleting proof of withdrawal.
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Retain the minimal applied-withdrawal proof; backup restore processing must reapply withdrawal before any derived publication.

entries.logical_domain: Account-owned journal file provenance and acquisition metadata
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through owner_account_id, composite with the owning private_import
entries.export_behavior: Include file metadata, content hash and import linkage; never raw journal content (not stored)
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Withdraw with the owning private import; tombstone by (journal_file_id, owner_account_id); backups expire and reapply the tombstone
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records the non-payload file tombstone by (journal_file_id, owner_account_id); backups expire and must reapply the tombstone.

entries.logical_domain: Account-owned normalized journal event with semantic dedupe identity
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through owner_account_id; do not infer ownership from source_run_id
entries.export_behavior: Include event key, allowlisted payload, timestamp and source linkage for the owner
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Withdraw with the owning private import; minimal non-payload tombstone; derived personal state recomputes from remaining events
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Ledger records a minimal non-payload event tombstone; backups expire and derived personal state must recompute from remaining events.

entries.logical_domain: Versioned explicit research-contribution consent decision ledger
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through owner_account_id; the decision can affect shared/public derived data
entries.export_behavior: Include consent version, decision history, purpose and audience
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Do not silently delete; withdraw via a WITHDRAW row and supersede dependent export batches; retain the minimal decision ledger
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Retain the minimal consent-decision ledger without private payload; restored backups must not resurrect a withdrawn consent decision.

entries.logical_domain: Deterministic sanitized export batch receipt with lineage supersede linkage
entries.ownership_resolution: Direct through owner_account_id; supersede linkage stays within the same owner
entries.export_behavior: Include receipt metadata and payload hash; payload is rebuilt deterministically on demand
entries.delete_withdraw_behavior: Supersede-not-delete; withdrawal supersedes by lineage token, never deletes the receipt
entries.backup_deletion_ledger_behavior: Retain the minimal supersede receipt ledger; backup restore processing must reapply supersession before any export replay.
